## Separate freeze/activation axes

| Axis | Proposed disposition | Gate before affirmative status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Scientific content acceptance | Accept r0.4 generic content only if owner review finds no material deviation. | Owner signs the exact generic source identity and hash; basis acceptance of r0.3 does not satisfy this gate. |
| Document-source freeze | Freeze the exact source package only after scientific-owner disposition and then a fresh post-owner consistency/exact-SHA review. | Manager final manifest/archive records reproduce; post-owner reviewer confirms the disposition is represented by the exact bytes with no unresolved scientific discrepancy. A pre-owner review cannot substitute. |

| Dependent numerical-route source closure | Withhold every source-closed/frozen route claim. | Later final immutable replacements or successors for the affected draft Registry/family/handoff/boundary routes, plus exact MAP/VAL binding and activation. Even then, selection/handoff/admission/application must be established per realization. |
| Implementation conformity and stronger claims | Remain `not_assessed` or unavailable as applicable. | Separate identified candidate and complete evidence under the ECS and claim-layer authorities. |

Package sealing and completed document build/PDF QA are reported by the
manager records delivered with the final candidate. Those mechanical outcomes
support document integrity and do not decide the scientific axes above.

## Required freeze sequence

1. The manager seals the reviewable candidate and its exact build/PDF/archive
   evidence.
2. The scientific owner disposes the exact r0.4 generic scientific-source
   bytes and separately states whether candidate profile/binding work is
   accepted for later Registry processing; silence is not approval.
3. A fresh implementation-blind reviewer, commissioned after that disposition,
   checks the owner decision against the exact bytes, source boundary,
   crosswalks, semantic parity, and hashes.
4. Only a passing post-owner review permits a generic scientific-authority
   freeze record. Route activation remains a later independent act.

Any review completed before owner disposition is useful candidate evidence but
does not satisfy step 3.
